newsitem.title: CANADA: Malette Quebec's Timmins Mill down on fire.
newsitem.headline: Malette Quebec's Timmins Mill down on fire.

text.p: Malette Quebec Inc said on Tuesday that its Timmins, Ontario strandboard timber mill closed after a fire last night damaged the facility.
Company officials told Reuters they had not entered the building yet and could not determine the extent of the damage, but said that water-bombing aircraft had to be used to extinguish the flames.
Malette officials said its annual strandboard production from its two plants including the Timmins plant was about four billion square feet.
